Master Services Agreement: Cypress Research
Parties: Cypress Example Studio LLC | Lantern Example Services LLC
Effective date: 2025-01-01

1. Choice of law
This Agreement is governed by the laws of Oregon.

2. Settlement
Invoices are payable within 75 days.

3. Ending the engagement
Either party may terminate for convenience with 15 days notice.

4. Renewal choice
This Agreement does not automatically renew.
The renewal term is 6 months.

5. Responsibility
Aggregate liability is unlimited.

6. Transfer
Assignment does not require prior written consent.
